caption: The drawing shows a single, oval-shaped bottle prominently in the center, rendered in shades of brown to resemble a ceramic or glass object. The bottle has a narrow neck and is decorated with raised designs; at the top, the word "ZANESVILLE" is written in an arc above a depiction of an eagle facing left, its wings partially spread, with a shield and olive branches in front of it. Below the eagle is an oval medallion with the word "OHIO" in capital letters, surrounded by dots. Around the bottom edge of the bottle are the words "THE PARDE CO." in raised letters. The main bottle is surrounded by a lightly drawn rectangular frame. In the upper left and lower right corners of the page are two smaller line drawings of the bottle; the upper left one shows a simple outline and contours, and the one in the lower right shows additional details and decorations similar to the main image but rendered in plain lines without color. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white or beige color.
title: Flask
